tCO2e/t/yr is refused
note: P14 remediation, engine 1.4.0. Previously COMPUTED: the old denominator test used a /T(?![A-Z0-9]) lookahead, which admits any non-alphanumeric suffix, so a per-year intensity was treated as a per-tonne one. This fixture pinned that behaviour as a recorded follow-up defect rather than as correct. The exact-token denominator rule closes it, and the expected value is re-derived here by hand rather than carried forward.

name: OPEN OWNER QUESTION: tCO2/t computes, treating CO2 as CO2e
note: A deliberate written decision in the engine, not an oversight -- but CO2 and CO2e are not the same quantity, and the difference is material for aluminium PFCs and fertiliser N2O. Pinned here so the decision is visible rather than buried, and recorded as an open question for the owner.

tCO2e/kilotonne is refused -- the spelled-out magnitude prefix, a 1000x overstatement
note: P14 remediation. The denominator check was a substring test for TONNE, and KILOTONNE contains TONNE. Verified accepted before the fix, so a producer typing a spelled-out prefix into emission_data.emission_unit (an unconstrained text column) produced a figure a thousand times too large through the trusted path.
